subject: Re: Status: curriculum results + tooling risks
body:
Team,

Decisions from Monday's review, with the 8/10 go/no-go in sight:

1. We narrow the zero-shot eval to the top three task families — form-filling, search-and-filter, and multi-step login flows — instead of all seven. The +21-point generalization result holds across families, but rater capacity doesn't: with Vera's UI live since 7/6, throughput supports deep human evals on three families, not thin ones on seven. Product only cares about those three anyway.
2. Curriculum config freezes 7/24; Halima's toolchain pin becomes the blessed build.
3. For 8/10 I'll present success rates plus the human ratings on task completion and safety — Quentin, please have the rating dashboards exportable by 8/5.

Ulla
